reason: This is the only available combination, and the threads should reinforce the plug.

effect: The mesh stopped the bleeding, but the skin remains open, so sealing the vessel is only the first part of repair.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the prepared threads reinforce the plug, and the open skin made the limit of the repair clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the threads to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: it showed how the two parts work together to stop bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was less engaging because it was the only available combination and mainly set up the next action.

surprise.text: The vessel stopped bleeding even though the skin above it was still open. That changed how I thought about stopping a leak versus healing a cut.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The named parts and pictures explained their purposes, though most choices after the first were the only available combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the open skin heals. The distinction between stopping bleeding and repairing the skin gives the next part a clear hook.
